metadata.data_quality_note: All probabilities sourced from real WebSearch + Polymarket MCP API results. Where search results gave ranges, noted explicitly. No probabilities fabricated. This update refreshes the 2026-02-07 dataset with 12-day-newer data points.

macro_events.probability_note: MCP API returned Yes=$0.235 (23.5%). Volume $231K. WebSearch showed range 23-31% across snapshots; MCP real-time value used as primary. Polymarket and Kalshi definitions differ slightly.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: Two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP (Q2 2025-Q4 2026) OR NBER recession announcement by BEA Q4 2026 advance estimate release
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - Recession would sharply reduce semiconductor capex; WFE spending historically drops 20-40% in recessions. LRCX revenue highly cyclical.

macro_events.probability_note: From WebSearch. Lower than recession probability because recession can be triggered by 2 negative quarters even if full-year is positive.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: Full-year 2026 GDP growth below 0% per BEA Advance Estimate for Q4 2026
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - Full-year negative GDP would indicate severe downturn for capital equipment demand

macro_events.probability_note: WebSearch returned range: 29% from one snapshot, 37% from another. Conservative range used. Separate from monthly CPI markets.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: BLS CPI reports for 2026 months showing annual inflation above 3%
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM - Higher inflation -> Fed holds rates higher -> higher discount rates for growth/capex stocks; raises input costs for fab construction

macro_events.resolution_criteria: BLS unemployment rate report shows 5.0% or higher at any point in 2026
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM - Rising unemployment signals weakening demand cycle; historically correlated with WFE capex deferrals by foundries and IDMs

macro_events.event: Fed 25bp rate cut at March 2026 FOMC meeting
macro_events.probability_note: Kalshi traders signal 64% for 25bp cut at March 17-18 FOMC. Significant divergence from Polymarket's earlier 87% No-change reading. Kalshi has 'perfect forecast record' per NBER study. Current rate 3.50-3.75%.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: Fed upper bound target rate decreased at March 2026 meeting
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH - Rate cuts positive for capital equipment sector; lower rates reduce cost of fab financing for LRCX customers (TSMC, Samsung, Intel)

macro_events.event: Fed rate cuts in 2026 - consensus ~2 cuts total
macro_events.probability_note: Multiple sources: futures pricing at most 2 rate reductions in 2026, first likely June. Fed held at 3.50-3.75% in Jan 2026 after 3 consecutive 25bp cuts in Sep/Oct/Dec 2025. Fed minutes (Feb 18) showed officials split on path forward.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: Based on Fed futures pricing, not a single binary market
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM - Gradual easing supports semiconductor capex planning; sudden reversal to tightening would be negative

macro_events.probability_note: Carried forward from prior collection; tail risk signal unchanged. Volume $34.7K.
macro_events.resolution_criteria: Fed funds rate upper bound increased at any point in 2026
macro_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM - Rate hike would signal inflation re-acceleration; negative for equipment investment cycle

industry_events.probability_note: 85% No / 15% Yes per WebSearch. Defined as any military encounter with use of force (missiles, gunfire, etc.) between PRC-ROC military forces, Nov 2025 - Dec 2026.
industry_events.resolution_criteria: Military encounter involving use of force between PRC and ROC military forces by Dec 31, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: CRITICAL - Taiwan hosts TSMC (LRCX's largest customer ~25-30% revenue); any military conflict would catastrophically disrupt global semiconductor supply chain

industry_events.event: China invades Taiwan by end of 2026
industry_events.probability_note: WebSearch indicated ~13%. Declined from ~30% in late 2025 per historical trend data. Separate from military clash (which includes lower-intensity confrontations).
industry_events.resolution_criteria: PRC commences military offensive to establish control over any portion of Taiwan by Dec 31, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: CRITICAL - Full invasion = TSMC fab destruction/inaccessibility; LRCX loses primary customer and installed base access

industry_events.probability_note: Shorter timeframe market; lower probability reflecting near-term assessment
industry_events.resolution_criteria: PRC military offensive against Taiwan by June 30, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: CRITICAL - Near-term tail risk for semiconductor supply chain

industry_events.probability_note: From WebSearch: 4% Yes as of Feb 17, 2026. Immediate-term risk assessment.
industry_events.resolution_criteria: PRC military offensive against Taiwan by March 31, 2026

industry_events.event: AI data center moratorium passed before 2027
industry_events.probability_note: MCP API returned Yes=$0.34 (34%). Volume $7,186. Last trade at $0.32. Resolves if US bill prohibiting/suspending approvals for new AI data center construction passed by Dec 31, 2026.
industry_events.resolution_criteria: US bill passed prohibiting/suspending approvals for new AI data center construction or major expansions by Dec 31, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - AI data center buildout drives advanced chip demand (HBM, leading-edge logic); moratorium would reduce TSMC/Samsung/Intel fab utilization and future capacity additions requiring LRCX etch equipment

industry_events.probability_note: Carried from prior collection. Volume $1.56M. Multi-condition resolution (NVDA -50%, SOXX -40%, major AI hardware suppliers -50%, etc.).
industry_events.resolution_criteria: At least 3 of: NVDA -50% / SOXX -40% / OpenAI/Anthropic bankruptcy / H100 rental <$1 for 5 days / major AI hardware supplier -50%, within 90-day window
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - LRCX ~35-40% revenue from advanced node equipment tied to AI chip demand. AI investment reversal would hit equipment orders first.

industry_events.probability_note: Carried from prior collection. Volume $167.6K. Near-term AI risk minimal.
industry_events.resolution_criteria: Same multi-condition as above, by March 31, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - Short-term AI collapse risk very low (4%), supportive of near-term equipment order outlook

industry_events.event: TSM quarterly earnings beat (GAAP EPS > $2.92, Q4 2025)
industry_events.probability_note: Historical market. TSM is LRCX's largest customer.
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - TSM earnings strength signals healthy semiconductor demand cycle; TSM capex guides LRCX equipment orders

industry_events.event: Supreme Court rules in favor of Trump's tariffs
industry_events.probability_note: Carried from prior collection. Volume $4M. 68% chance tariffs ruled unconstitutional.
industry_events.resolution_criteria: Supreme Court rules in favor of presidential tariff authority
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: HIGH - If tariffs upheld (32%), solidifies legal basis for China chip equipment export controls; if struck down (68%), trade tensions may ease, benefiting LRCX China revenue (~30%)
MEDIUM - Visit may signal temporary China-US relations thaw; potential for semiconductor export control discussions

industry_events.resolution_criteria: DeepSeek publicly releases V4 model by March 31, 2026
industry_events.lrcx_relevance: MEDIUM - Chinese AI advancement may accelerate demand for domestic chips (positive) but also strengthen case for tighter US export controls (negative for LRCX China revenue)

no_coverage.event: LRCX-specific prediction markets (earnings, stock price, revenue targets)
no_coverage.note: No active Polymarket or Kalshi markets found for Lam Research. MCP search for 'Lam Research LRCX semiconductor equipment' returned only tangentially related results. LRCX is not covered as a standalone prediction market subject.

no_coverage.event: Chip export ban / US-China semiconductor equipment restrictions
no_coverage.note: WebSearch for 'site:polymarket.com chip export ban' returned ZERO relevant results. No active prediction markets found for US semiconductor export controls, entity list additions, or equipment trade restrictions. THIS IS THE MOST SIGNIFICANT COVERAGE GAP given LRCX's ~30% China revenue exposure and the regulatory overhang from existing BIS restrictions.

no_coverage.event: AI capex spending levels (specific dollar amounts)
no_coverage.note: WebSearch for 'site:polymarket.com AI spending' found 85 AI-related markets but none on AI capital expenditure levels or hyperscaler spending amounts. Closest proxy: 'AI data center moratorium' (34%) and 'AI bubble burst' (20%).

no_coverage.event: WFE (Wafer Fab Equipment) market size / semiconductor capex cycle
no_coverage.note: No prediction markets exist for WFE market forecasts, semiconductor equipment spending levels, or fab utilization rates.

no_coverage.event: CHIPS Act funding disbursement / semiconductor subsidy milestones
no_coverage.note: No prediction markets found for US CHIPS Act implementation milestones or funding disbursement timelines.

no_coverage.note: No prediction markets for Chinese semiconductor equipment localization progress. This is a long-term structural risk for LRCX's China business.
No prediction markets for storage capex cycle. Memory represents ~25-30% of LRCX revenue.

macro_context.fed_status: Fed funds rate at 3.50-3.75% after holding steady in Jan 2026. Three 25bp cuts in Sep/Oct/Dec 2025. Jan 2026 minutes (released Feb 18) showed officials split between inflation fighting and labor market support.
macro_context.fed_status_source: Federal Reserve official announcement + CNBC/JPMorgan reporting
macro_context.ai_capex_2026_consensus: Hyperscaler AI capex ~$700B (2026), +36% YoY per BofA. Alphabet $175-185B, Meta $115-135B, Amazon ~$200B.
ai_capex_2026_sources: Goldman Sachs: AI companies may invest >$500B in 2026
CNBC (2026-02-06): Tech AI spending approaches $700B in 2026
macro_context.ai_capex_implication_for_lrcx: AI capex surge drives advanced node expansion (3nm/2nm), where LRCX etch steps per layer increase 15-20% per node. $700B hyperscaler capex is strongest demand backdrop in LRCX history. Counter-risk: AI bubble burst (20%) or data center moratorium (34%) could halt the cycle.
